title: Assembly function modifications: conventions and project knowledge params
description:
Modify `lib/context/assembly.py` to add `conventions: str = ''` and `project_knowledge: str = ''` optional parameters to all three assembly functions. Each function inserts new sections at the specified location in the prompt.

**`assemble_developer()`** — add params after existing `learnings` param. Insert `### Project Conventions` section (if conventions non-empty) after Cross-Cutting Constraints and before Learned Patterns. Insert `### Project Knowledge` section (if project_knowledge non-empty) after conventions and before Learned Patterns. Each insertion deducts from `total_budget` via `estimate_tokens_from_text()`.

**`assemble_reviewer()`** — same new params. Insert `### Convention Checklist` section after Assumptions to Verify, before Review Calibration. Insert `### Project Knowledge` after Convention Checklist, before Review Calibration.

**`assemble_architect()`** — same new params. Insert `### Structural Conventions` section after Directory Structure, before Project History. Insert `### Project Knowledge` after Structural Conventions, before Project History.

The section insertion order matters for token budget priority: conventions first, then knowledge, then learnings (existing). When `_truncate()` clips from the end, learnings are cut first.

Existing callers pass neither param and get the empty-string defaults, so no callers break. Locate the exact insertion points by finding the existing section headers in each function's `sections` list construction.
acceptance_criteria:
- assemble_developer() accepts conventions='' and project_knowledge='' without breaking existing callers
- assemble_developer() with conventions='test content' includes '### Project Conventions' section in output
- assemble_developer() with project_knowledge='test content' includes '### Project Knowledge' section in output
- assemble_developer() with empty conventions string omits the Project Conventions section entirely
- assemble_reviewer() with conventions string includes '### Convention Checklist' section in output
- assemble_reviewer() with project_knowledge string includes '### Project Knowledge' section in output
- assemble_architect() with conventions string includes '### Structural Conventions' section in output
- assemble_architect() with project_knowledge string includes '### Project Knowledge' section in output
- Section ordering in developer: Cross-Cutting Constraints < Project Conventions < Project Knowledge < Learned Patterns
- Section ordering in reviewer: Assumptions to Verify < Convention Checklist < Project Knowledge < Review Calibration
- Section ordering in architect: Directory Structure < Structural Conventions < Project Knowledge < Project History
- Each section insertion deducts tokens from total_budget via estimate_tokens_from_text()
- No type errors in lib/context/assembly.py
